claims.quote: Our rock-solid support to Ukraine is vital for keeping us safe here in the UK
claims.statement: UK support to Ukraine is vital for keeping the UK safe and for ensuring frontline forces have the equipment they need to push back Russia.

entities.name: Andy Burnham
entities.role: Prime Minister of the United Kingdom

claims.quote: we are with you for as long as it takes
claims.statement: The UK is with Ukraine for as long as it takes and will go further and faster in its support.

entities.name: Andy Burnham
entities.role: Prime Minister of the United Kingdom

claims.quote: Russia’s aggression cannot be allowed to succeed on our continent.
claims.statement: Russia's aggression cannot be allowed to succeed in Europe.

entities.name: Andy Burnham
entities.role: Prime Minister of the United Kingdom

claims.quote: The Prime Minister has also asked Ministers to draw up further sanctions, military aid, and fiscal packages
claims.statement: The Prime Minister has asked Ministers to draw up further sanctions, military aid and fiscal packages to provide urgent support in the coming weeks.

claims.quote: our commitment to the Ukrainian people is unshakeable
claims.statement: The UK's commitment to the Ukrainian people is unshakeable.

claims.quote: I urge partners to back the ban on Russian LNG
claims.statement: International partners should back a ban on Russian LNG, as the UK has done.

claims.quote: to curtail the war chest funding Putin so desperately wants
claims.statement: A ban on Russian LNG would curtail the funds Putin relies on for the war.

facts.quote: President Zelenskyy will arrive in the UK this morning
facts.statement: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy was due to arrive in the UK on the morning of 2026-10-13 to meet the Prime Minister.

facts.statement: The Prime Minister was to host President Volodymyr Zelenskyy at Downing Street.

The UK is delivering £45 million of surface-to-air missiles to Ukraine.
